name: l2_scn_0906_creature_labor_substitutes_industry_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0906 (Creature Labor Substitutes Industry) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. Instead of broad mechanization, society relies on bonded beings for transport, energy, construction, and services - creating high capability but uneven standardization and rights. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
